# Quinta da Touriga-Chã

> Family wine estate in the Douro Superior, near Vila Nova de Foz Côa, Portugal. Touriga Nacional grown on schist, made by the Rosas family, now in its sixth generation. Company: Jorge Rosas, Vinhos - Unipessoal Lda.

The estate was founded by José António Castro Ramos Pinto Rosas (1919-1996), known as the Pioneer of the Douro, who at 72 acquired a virgin 20-hectare property and planted 8.5 hectares from scratch, with more than 80% Touriga Nacional. Today the estate covers about 40 hectares and is managed by his son Jorge Rosas, the fifth generation. A winery was built in 2004.

Wines:
- Quinta da Touriga-Chã: the flagship red, predominantly Touriga Nacional.
- Puro: a virgin, unfortified wine, a raw expression of the schistous soil.
